name: Calm Notes
audience: busy people who want a two-minute daily reflection
outcome: a phone-friendly web app where a person writes one short reflection a day, sees a streak, and gets a gentle reminder
stack: static PWA (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), offline first
constraints: No account needed; data stays on the device
Works offline after the first visit
mustNot: No tracking or analytics without the owner's approval

features.title: First open
features.acceptance: A new user reaches today's page in under 30 seconds.

features.title: Write today
features.failure: Storage full: keep the text on screen and show a calm message.
features.acceptance: A reflection survives closing and reopening the app.

features.title: Daily reminder
steps: Ask permission at the right moment
